title: Multipath stage coordinator and NCCL congestion mitigator for multi-GPU prefill/decode
text:
Multipath stage coordinator and NCCL congestion mitigator for multi-GPU prefill/decode

description:
Goal: reduce p95/p99 tail during prefill+decode for models running with tensor+pipeline parallelism by coordinating stage handoffs, making kernel selection latency-aware, and smoothing NCCL usage to exploit communication/computation overlap. Background: recent load tests show spiky NCCL bursts when large prefill batches arrive and decode waves interleave across stages. This causes queueing at rendezvous points and kernel selection thrashing (switches between fast float kernels and quantized kernels) which increases tail latency. Proposed approach: 1) introduce a Multipath Stage Coordinator (MSC) that exports per-stage backlog and calculates routed microbatch windows; 2) add an NCCL congestion mitigator that enforces soft credit windows per-link and inserts small stagger offsets to create comm-compute overlap without hurting throughput; 3) surface kernel selection hints from MSC (sequence-length and hardware availability signals) so the runtime prefers low-latency kernels for tail-sensitive waves and higher-throughput kernels for bulk prefill; 4) implement lightweight admission control for decode waves to avoid head-of-line blocking. Success metrics: p99 decode latency reduction >= 12% under mixed prefill-decode workload, end-to-end throughput drop <= 3% in steady-state, no increased OOMs or deadlocks. Constraints: must be compatible with existing NCCL-based rendezvous; changes should be opt-in feature flag for Dedicated/Private deployments. Rollout plan includes shadow mode telemetry and a canary on 8-GPU pool before platform-wide rollout.

comments:
2025-02-18 Marco Li: Created ticket after postmortem of 2025-02-15 test night where 8-GPU prefills caused 250ms p99 spikes. Root cause suspected contention on NCCL all-reduce windows and aggressive kernel switching.
2025-02-21 Sofia Alvarez: Spike reproduction harness added in perf-suite. Reproduced spikes with seq=2048 prefill batches interleaved with single-token decode bursts; baseline p99=248ms, p50=32ms.
2025-02-24 Design sync: decided to keep MSC in the runtime (not control plane) to keep handoff latency predictable. Trade-off: more runtime complexity vs lower control-plane latency and simpler rollbacks.
2025-02-27 Marco Li: Prototype MSC that emits per-stage backlog and estimated rendezvous time. Early experiments: staggering rendezvous by 4-8ms reduced NCCL peak bandwidth by 18% while lowering p99 by 9%. Saved telemetry in perf dashboard.
2025-03-01 Sofia Alvarez: Implemented kernel-hint API (runtime -> kernel selector) and a conservative policy: prefer low-latency kernels when predicted rendezvous delta < threshold. Integration tests passing locally.
2025-03-03 Review Feedback from Reliability: add watchdog to detect starvation of pipeline stages when credit windows shrink; suggested max-backlog cap and controlled backpressure signals.
2025-03-04 Marco Li: Opened PR for MSC core and congestion mitigator: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2148. Perf traces and flamegraphs attached in the PR. Requesting review from @natalie-ops and @cheng-huang.
2025-03-04 Sofia Alvarez: Runbook draft added—how to flip feature flags, telemetry to watch (nccl_bytes, rendezvous_wait_ms, kernel_switch_count, p99_decode_ms). Confluence design doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INF/pages/54678/Multi-GPU+Coordinator

acceptance_criteria:
p99 decode latency reduced by at least 12% in mixed prefill/decode benchmark relative to baseline under the same load profile
End-to-end throughput decrease <= 3% for steady-state prefill throughput compared to baseline
No regression in memory usage (peak GPU memory within 2% of baseline) and zero new deadlocks in stress suite
Feature guarded behind runtime flag; can be toggled without restart for Dedicated/Private customers
Observability: metrics emitted for rendezvous_delay_ms, nccl_credit_usage, kernel_hint_rate, and stage_backlog, with dashboards and alerts configured
